scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @parcelproof/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @parcelproof/shared && npm run build --workspace @parcelproof/api && npm run build --workspace @parcelproof/web && npm run build --workspace @parcelproof/infrastructure
scripts.cdk:synth: npm run build && cdk synth --app "node infrastructure/dist/app.js"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node infrastructure/dist/app.js" --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json
